translatorChecks.reviewerNotes: Preserved every paragraph (including the four-paragraph quoted letter), repetitions, stutters, truncations, brackets, braces, and ellipses. The opaque quoted 'בנק קלירס' is transliterated as 'Bank Klirs.' The OCR-like Yiddish line is translated contextually as the established phrase 'My little fire will smolder until Moshiach comes' without altering canonical Hebrew.

qa.reviewNotes: Approved clause by clause. All 26 paragraphs and both bracketed turns are present, including the four-paragraph quoted letter. Checked the repeated livelihood/bread clauses, duplicated harsh-punishment wording, four-part th.. stutter, house/death false start, the full braced ‘what he…saw’ fragment, repeated providence wording, every ho, the first/second-note contrast, Tzipporah false start, all single and doubled braces, ellipsis-only turn, and both final bread/children stutters. The opaque ‘Bank Klirs’ is transliterated without normalization, and the Yiddish line is contextually rendered by the established ‘My little fire will smolder until Moshiach comes’ wording. No unsupported stage direction, addition, or text from 71-a-002 was found.
